column2: Smartbuoy provides a point measurement at roughly 51.98°N, 2.08°E (it moves around slightly with redeployments), old ferry bottle data data was taken at 52°N, 2°E.
Ferry bottle data measured monthly covering 1971-2002; Smartbuoy measurements taken every 15 minutes from 2002 to present. Only quality controlled data is reported.
Regression to combine old ferry data and Smartbuoy data involves deseasoning data (annual mean anomalies are average of monthly mean anomalies).

1971-2002 - West Gabbard Smartbuoy location reconstructed from Harwich to Rotterdam Station 3 monthly timeseries by calibration during an overlapping period 2002-2012. 2003-onwards annual average anomaly West Gabbard Smartbuoy. Absolute values are RECONSTRUCTED!
